title: The BP exchange: res/field/shops/bp_shops.json
description: The Battle Subway's and the PWT's BP exchange counters, shops 254 (items) and 253 (TMs), in the order of BP_SHOP_ITEMS in src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c. The matching build keeps its C tables; Paper White 2's build writes them from this file (tools/data/shop_data.py header, paperwhite2/shops_config.h). A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

shop.description: The shop's ID, as the scripts give it

name.description: Where the shop is, for people and editors; the game doesn't read it

items.description: The goods in menu order, at least one and at most 45 (ShopUIWork's entries)
